kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يحتضران (form VIII)
# يَحْتَضِرَانِ (yaḥtaḍirāni) /jaħ.ta.dˤi.raː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# يُحْتَضَرَانِ (yuḥtaḍarāni) /juħ.ta.dˤa.raː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
